findings.title: Live source application misses unrelated staged index changes whose working bytes are restored
findings.description: Both the initial clean-check and new repeated scope check use a direct baseline-to-working-tree diff. That net comparison does not independently inspect the index. A real staged MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md modification remains in the index after the working file is restored to accepted bytes. With actual HEAD unchanged and every captured working input exact, real prepare and apply complete, and the genuine historical completed proof verifies. The unrelated staged state exists before source mutation but is never refused.
findings.reproduction: Root actual private fixtures stage changed MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md and restore its worktree bytes, either before prepare or between prepare and apply. I read the entire root probe and four outcomes, rehashed actual receipts, independently read actual Git index/blob/worktree differences with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0, and invoked unchanged native verify_completed on the three completed fixtures. Index files remained unchanged by my readback.

actual.HEAD: equals each accepted baseline
actual.changed_working_bytes_control: refused before receipt or source mutation

findings.lineage: Partial correction of original W08-16C-CODE-002/#1256. Exact21061 correctly refuses the old late-empty-commit and net unrelated-working-change cases, but does not satisfy staged-context freshness in this cancellation case. Historical verify_completed is not itself the live-transaction defect.
findings.bounded_fix: Independently verify literal staged/index state as well as working-tree state at live preparation and transaction rechecks. Bind the accepted index/allowed-scope policy explicitly; do not infer index cleanliness from hashes of working files or their net baseline diff. Refuse unrelated staged changes before mutation, retain postwrite failed/recovery evidence for observed late drift, preserve NUL path handling and existing current-owner/proof checks. Do not add an unconditional index/HEAD lock to historical verification.
required_tests: Actual stage unrelated content then restore working bytes before prepare: refuse without source/receipt mutation.
Same hidden index change between prepare and apply: refuse before reservation and writes.
Hidden unrelated index change during write/final-flush checkpoints: no success-shaped receipt; retain authentic recovery evidence.
Positive truly clean transactions and exact completed historical proof after legitimate later commits remain supported.
Retain ordinary staged/working changes and literal Unicode/newline negatives; do not weaken either scope inventory.

separate_publisher_referral.scope: Peer independently owns full publisher reproduction. I read exact finding and current callback/recheck interface; I did not duplicate its full source-to-generator publication probe.
